name: homeassistant-powercalc-portable-profile-e043
instr:
Powercalc cannot export the profile chosen by normal resolution for backup, transfer, or offline troubleshooting. Build deterministic, portable ZIP bundles without changing lookup, listing, sensor selection, or calculations.

Every Loader exports normalized, source-identified resources with stable encoding, digests, paths, and bundle identity regardless of enumeration order. LocalLoader exports model.json and every referenced file from the resolved local model directory while confining all resources to that directory; escaping paths publish nothing. RemoteLoader uses verified installed cache data, makes no offline network requests, and reports unavailable data. CompositeLoader uses the first successful child and its provenance without merging shadowed resources. Missing models keep the existing no-match result.

Obtain `ProfileLibrary` through its existing factory in `custom_components.powercalc.power_profile`. Use ordinary resolution so aliases, migrations, precedence, canonical identity, listing order, profile selection, and calculations remain unchanged regardless of operation order. Changes, corruption, failure, or cancellation publish nothing, preserve the destination byte for byte, and permit retry. Replace successful bundles atomically.

Bundles remain self-contained and verifiable after source storage disappears. Verification needs no network or loader initialization and deterministically distinguishes missing, extra, and corrupted resources. Retain profile and reques
